title: Halo Dental hero
description: Full-screen black hero framed inside a rounded inset border over the warm stone page: a monumental display wordmark anchored bottom-left on desktop, a 64px headline aligned to column 8 on the right, and a vertical hardware studio placeholder with a split orange video button on phones.
notes: Pass a custom media ReactNode to replace the default studio backdrop placeholder
The inset frame uses 6px padding on phones and 10px on desktop with 8px rounded corners
